author: Bobby Grayson
description:
Major architectural refactor introducing separate crates:
- grep-matcher: Matcher trait for pattern matching engines
- grep-regex: Rust regex implementation of Matcher
- grep-pcre2: PCRE2 implementation of Matcher  
- grep-searcher: Searches files using a Matcher
- grep-printer: Sink trait for output formatting
- grep-cli: CLI utilities

Three distinct phases decoupled by traits:
1. Pattern matching (Matcher trait)
2. Searching (uses Matcher)
3. Printing (Sink trait)

Sources:
- d9ca529: 'libripgrep is not any one library, but rather, a collection of libraries that roughly separate the following key distinct phases in a grep implementation: 1. Pattern matching (e.g., by a regex engine). 2. Searching a file using a pattern matcher. 3. Printing results... Closes #162'
title: Created libripgrep: decoupled crate collection
